Its planning policy explicitly forbids repeating that replay without a fresh current trace contradicting a named certified invariant.

The earlier kernel_start_precedes_stage0_input and kernel_start_precedes_direct_core_ingress failures are diagnostic-contract inconsistencies, not proven RTL failures. Live hierarchical knowledge requires an accepted input handshake before lifecycle start, and the successful replay binds the start witness to the first accepted core ingress.

The unresolved board symptom remains real but is only localization evidence: the old exact-board trace accepted all 1792 core ingress beats while ready core egress accepted zero. Partial probes reached 607 transfers at stage_06_activation_mul to stage_07_mlp_down_proj while stage-07 output accepted zero, but complete records for all required boundaries were unavailable. This does not preselect block_input, MLP-down RTL, or the connected kernel as root cause.

The prior repair execution correctly blocked another VCS run because the testbench emitted unavailable observations for every listed incomplete boundary and lacked verified hierarchy paths and payload bindings. The earliest actionable violated contract is therefore exact-sample debug observability: actual valid, ready, transfer, accepted-count, and first/last accepted payload digest records are required for all 12 incomplete boundaries, completing the 13-boundary CCTG path.

The old run's termination classification sets source_semantic_repair_eligible=false. It supports a checker, harness, or instrumentation repair but does not authorize a behavioral adapter, connected-kernel change, or output-side patch.

The source-token case_deadlock_axi_check assumptions conflict with the passed discovered board interface. Its generic io_m_axi_* and fixed testbench-token requirements must be discovery-bound to the exact wrapper ABI rather than satisfied through aliases, fake markers, or simplified wrapper text.

sacg_memory_truth reports 24 active same-scope contamination barriers and eight open retry requests, with zero open same-scope backtrack requests. These barriers make rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts planning evidence only and block downstream promotion; they do not independently block the bounded current-stage repair. They may be retired only by normal successful Stage7 promotion, not by manual clearing.

The immutable semantic evidence remains available but has not produced a board pass: expected output sha256 92fc53de80c8caca6ea04cc69ab768a1f6db0e55a2ab0ebbd9ac0adc6e3c85b4 comes from target_model_inference, and the semantic testbench hash is 508f38c4b8fb9c1ac16e8191cccc4ee1a15f3ab862cfbfbb3821f312646df82f. No numeric or semantic pass may be claimed until a new executed DUT output is compared under the unchanged policy.

Accelerator scope remains Transformer blocks only. Embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work must not be added to the DUT, weight-coverage requirements, or golden boundary.
proposed_actions: First reconcile the erroneous start-before-ingress diagnostic invariant against the hash-validated accepted-ingress-before-start lifecycle knowledge; preserve the unresolved board output symptom without assigning an RTL root cause.
Extract a complete read-only current-DAG signal provenance map from the certified connected-kernel source closure. Do not rerun or edit the connected kernel.

Using only the accepted map, replace unavailable boundary observations with schema-valid testbench-only monitors for all 12 incomplete boundaries; preserve functional stimulus, control, golden, numeric policy, and exact-wrapper hashes.
Repair the deadlock/AXI diagnostic selector contract to consume board_source_identity, discovered AXI names, manifests, and real pass/counter evidence instead of hardcoded generic source tokens.

After all static observability and human-boundary checks pass, rerun the exact-board VCS functional simulation and analyzer on the same immutable checkpoint, stimulus, reference, weights, numeric policy, and exact wrapper.

Only after functional_sim passes, execute the remaining current board-layer gate DAG and assemble board semantic evidence. Do not schedule Vivado, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime before complete current-layer closure.
risks: Guessing hierarchy expressions or relying on supplied module names without source-path and SHA-256 provenance could monitor the wrong instance and create false localization evidence.

Changing DUT ports, state, valid/ready behavior, lifecycle sequencing, the exact wrapper, or adding a behavioral adapter merely to expose probes would cross the human boundary and invalidate certified lower-layer evidence.
Repeating VCS before complete static observability closure would reproduce an expensive unlocalizable run and violate the prior repair feedback.

Treating unequal stage durations or lack of same-cycle concurrency as a defect would contradict the certified elastic variable-latency pipeline semantics; required boundary order and cross-token overlap are the relevant timing contracts.

The current transfer contract must remain consistent across shape and data order: sequence length 16, width 896, 112 256-bit stream beats per token, 1792 core stream beats, 896 aligned 512-bit AXI beats, and token/tile/lane/word order. Monitor packing or digest logic must not reinterpret these facts.

The numeric policy, checkpoint, reference output, stimulus, tolerance, and semantic testbench contract are immutable. Instrumentation must not modify data, derive expected values from RTL output, or loosen comparison thresholds.

Runtime loader observations from the failed run, including 1056 accepted words, are not a runtime-loader pass because the executed acceptance bindings were incomplete. Loader, address, layer-count, and weight-consumption closure must come from the new manifest-bound execution.

The configured board validation scope covers one validation layer and all its required tensors, not all 24 model layers. A prefix liveness result must not be represented as full 24-layer Transformer-block semantic correctness.

Active SACG contamination barriers and retry requests remain promotion blockers even after a patch is generated; consuming patched artifacts as validated inputs before a fresh Stage7 pass would contaminate backend work.
